description:
Ready or Not: Boiling Point is available now!

The relentlessly debased city of Los Sueños faces an existential crisis when a subversive terror attack severs any remaining faith in what's become an ineffective and overwhelmingly militarized city government.

Owners of Ready or Not: Boiling Point will have access to several new customization items. Cosmetic items include ADV Headset, Tactical Beanie, Tactical Cap, Bone Conduction Tactical Headset, Tactical Rebreather Gasmask, ‘Artemis’ Heavy Tactical Vest, Machinex Fingerless Gloves, 4 DLC exclusive tattoos, and more.

The DLC features three new missions: ‘No Good Deed’, ‘All Gods Burn’ and ‘A New America’. The brand-new missions will be playable in multiplayer lobbies for non-DLC owners if they join a host who has purchased the new DLC.

Reclaim power. Reach beyond. The fight for Pywel begins on March 19, 2026 on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC.

Join Kliff the Greymane as he embarks across the continent of Pywel to rebuild what has been lost and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ancient ruins and the mystery of the Abyss, explore the lands and forge your path through battles and discovery in this open-world action-adventure.

(The footage captured in this trailer was captured on PC.)

About Crimson Desert  
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. The Greymane Kliff is determined to reunite with his surviving comrades and rebuild what was lost. But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions

Return to old-school roleplaying: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/greedfall-the-dying-world/9PDWZ4GBDJSD/

Step back into the world of GreedFall! The Dying World sees you taken to the Old Continent, far from the lands you call home, break the bonds of your captors, reclaim your freedom and build allies. 

Your journey will carry you across lands plagued by a terrifying disease, while various factions play for position. Make choices throughout the story, who to trust, which companions to bring and how you deal with the unfolding chaos before you. Depending on your actions, allies may turn to enemies, love may bloom, and the fate of these lands will be decided.
 
GreedFall: The Dying World is available now on Xbox Series X|S."
